name: Attribution Quarantine Hard Gate
hypothesis: Hard-blocking SPC/delta outputs when blank/unknown attribution rows appear will eliminate false anomaly classifications.
change: Treat any blank/unknown model/provider row as data-quality-invalid for aggregation input; emit only data_quality_blocked diagnostics until clean.
measurement: Track unknown/blank-row incidence, count of unknown-stratum SPC alerts, and percentage of retros with valid deltas.
risk: More retros may be blocked initially, increasing short-term operational friction.

previous_experiment.name: Worktree-Agnostic Retro Ingestion
previous_experiment.final_summary: Retro now reads efficiency data from canonical repo-root paths. Current run produced non-zero cost/duration/token metrics ($1.0764/bead avg), confirming the worktree log visibility fix works. Remaining data-quality issues (blank attribution rows) are a separate concern addressed by the next experiment.
